from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,csv
from v3_revision import ROOT,dump
r=ROOT/'results/revision-20261023/round2';sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
b=json.loads((r/'final-verification-binding-information-scope-g13.json').read_text());assert all(sha(p)==h for p,h in b['sha256'].items())
f=json.loads((r/'post-correction-audit/quality-assessment-current-facts.json').read_text());assert all(hashlib.sha256((r/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in f['source_identity'].items());assert sum(m['complete'] for m in f['methods'])==18 and sum(m['NA'] for m in f['methods'])==6
q=next(x for x in f['methods'] if x['method']=='QRF');assert q['comparisons']['frozen_F']['lower']==2 and q['comparisons']['QR']['lower']==5
note=(ROOT/'notes/v3-quality-assessment-checkpoint.md').read_text();assert 'Quantile forests, CAViaR, full volatility-filtered historical simulation and sequential conformal procedures have not been evaluated on this target.' not in note
assert 'obsolete' in note and 'different tuning budgets' in note and 'compatible unseen second dealer' in note and f['pdf_sha256'] in note
files=['notes/v3-quality-assessment-checkpoint.md','results/revision-20261023/round2/README.md']+[str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in (r/'post-correction-audit').glob('*assessment*.json')]
for p in files:
 if p.endswith('.json'):json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text())
report={'current_PDF_and_55_prior_binding_hashes_unchanged':True,'assessment_inputs_match':True,'all_D1_cells':24,'complete':18,'NA':6,'QRF_lower_higher_vs_F':[2,6],'QRF_lower_higher_vs_QR':[5,3],'assessment_sha256':sha('notes/v3-quality-assessment-checkpoint.md'),'new_assessment_files':{p:sha(p) for p in files},'numerical_experiments_rerun':False,'independent_dealer_replication_obtained':False,'specific_publication_tier_established':False}
dump(r/'post-correction-audit/quality-assessment-delivery-binding.json',report);print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
